response.original_title: How do I add passengers to my Cunard Cruise?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing reservation by calling Cunard directly at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK), or by contacting your travel advisor.  Important Details for Adding a Guest  Cannot be done online: You cannot add passengers through the Cunard website or mobile app.  Capacity limits: Your stateroom must have space (such as a sofa bed or Pullman berth) and the ship must have available lifeboat and muster station capacity.  Pricing updates: Your booking will typically be re-priced at current fare rates, and you must pay any extra cruise fares, taxes, and port charges for the new guest.  Required information: Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and payment details ready when you call.  Travel agents: If you booked through a travel agent, they must make the changes to your reservation for you.
